name: paperless-storage
description: Embed documents from your paperless-ngx instance directly in your notes.

scripts.version-bump: test -f ../tools/release/version-bump.mjs || { echo "FEHLER: ../tools/release/ fehlt. Ein Clone ohne Dach ist nicht release-faehig." >&2; exit 1; }; node ../tools/release/version-bump.mjs
